visualReview.notes: All 10 final portable views inspected. The historic principal ensemble includes the stone Blore residential range with projecting oriel and paired polygonal turrets, red-brick western towers, chapel and returned cloister ranges, the long Great Hall with tall closed glazing, roof dormers and a closed roof lantern, and the low eastern courtyard range. The integral separately mapped Morton gatehouse has two taller brick towers around a lower recessed bridge, a closed main timber gate and a separate smaller closed side door. The actual cloister court, main forecourt and space between the gatehouse towers remain open. Original quoins, mullions, battlements, roof trim and chimneys replace detailed historic ornament; heraldry, sculpture, text and interiors are excluded. Isolated turntable views expose the deliberately buried foundations.
